# Why East contract revenue fell from late January 2026

**The fall is real, but it comes entirely from D07 Fenmarsh and D08 Wickhollow.** The most likely explanation in the data is that Pemberwick Groundworks did not renew its contract, which ended on 16 January. I can't confirm this from revenue alone because the data has no customer-level breakdown.

## Checking the drop

Comparing the 10 weeks before (3 Nov–5 Jan) with the 10 weeks from 26 Jan to 30 Mar:

| Depot | Avg/week before | Avg/week after | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| D07 Fenmarsh | 23,779 | 17,112 | −6,667 (−28%) |
| D08 Wickhollow | 17,347 | 13,583 | −3,764 (−22%) |
| D09 Dunstrand | 14,324 | 15,663 | +1,339 (+9%) |
| **East total** | **55,450** | **46,357** | **−9,093 (−16%)** |

Two details about the shape of the decline:
- **Lowest point:** the three weeks from 2 to 16 Feb, at €38–42k per week.
- **Partial recovery:** March reached €44–52k, which is still below the November–December level.

## What points to Pemberwick Groundworks

- **16 Dec (D07):** Pemberwick told staff it would not renew when the contract ended on 16 January.
- **20 Jan (D07):** Final Pemberwick off-hire collections were completed.
- **21 Jan (D08):** The last two Pemberwick excavators were collected.

These notes line up with the data in two ways:
- **Timing:** the collections finished just before the late-January drop.
- **Location:** they cover exactly the two depots that declined. D09 has no Pemberwick note and its revenue rose.

## Other explanations the data rules out

- **Price changes:** none affect East. The changes listed are for South (from 6 Apr), North (from 4 May) and West (from 6 Jul).
- **Missing data:** no weekly files are missing for East depots.
- **Carrick Stowe closure:** this depot is in the West region, so it doesn't affect East figures.

## What the data can't show

- **How much Pemberwick was worth.** Without customer-level revenue, I can't confirm what share of the roughly €9k/week drop is Pemberwick versus other customers.
- **Seasonality.** There is no prior-year data, so a normal winter dip can't be ruled out.
- **Some weakness started before the contract ended.** The week of 12 Jan was already low (€42,239), and D07 was trending down from December. Pemberwick may not explain the whole decline.
